description: Wind River Linux Secure uses Network Security Services (NSS) to provide a set of libraries designed to support cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server applications. Applications built with WRLS can support SSL v2 and v3, TLS, PKCS #5, PKCS #7, PKCS #11, PKCS #12, S/MIME, X.509 v3 certificates, and other security standards.
